slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Cinematic lighting uses contrast, direction, and color to create mood
Use motivated light sources—windows, lamps, screens
Cinematic lighting is about intention, not brightness

slides.heading: MOTIVATED LAYOUT
slides.caption: Motivated key, negative fill for depth, warm vs cool separation.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Turn off overheads—they kill cinematic mood.
